tools.name: audio_status
tools.description: Report which audio capabilities are wired up right now (listen, transcribe, speak, sing, convert, play). Call it before promising any audio output when you are unsure.

summary.zh: 报告语音能力此刻的接入状态。
summary.en: Reports which audio capabilities are wired up right now.

tools.name: audio_play
tools.description: Play an audio file now (a local path, or a log:/mem: blob handle); later requests queue up behind it. Returns the queue id and position — playback finishes in the background, so do not wait for it.

path.description: Absolute path to the audio file; give this or handle.

volume.description: Volume for this item; defaults to the configured volume.

handle.description: A log:/mem: blob handle for the audio; give this or path.

summary.zh: 播放一个音频文件，后面的排队。
summary.en: Plays an audio file; later requests queue up.

tools.name: audio_say
tools.description: Say a line with the configured speech engine and play it through the audio queue. Returns at once: synthesis and playback run in the background, and only a failure comes back as an audio.say_failed event. With silent=true it synthesizes in the background without playback and the file path comes back as an audio.say_done event.

voice.description: Optional voice for this line; empty uses the configured one.

summary.zh: 按当前引擎合成一句话并播放。
summary.en: Synthesizes a line with the current engine and plays it.

tools.name: audio_convert
tools.description: Convert an audio file (a local path, or a log:/mem: blob handle) into the configured RVC voice and play the result through the audio queue. Returns at once: conversion runs in the background, the result lands in the speech records, and only a failure comes back as an audio.convert_failed event.

path.description: Absolute path to the audio file; give this or handle.

voice.description: Optional voice file name (the .pth in the voice folder); empty uses the configured one.

handle.description: A log:/mem: blob handle for the audio; give this or path.

silent.description: Convert only; do not play. The path and an audio blob handle come back as an audio.convert_done event.

summary.zh: 把一段音频换成当前变声音色，转完自动播放。
summary.en: Converts an audio file into the configured voice and plays it.

tools.name: audio_sing
tools.description: Sing the given lyrics with the configured DiffSinger voicebank and play the song through the audio queue. Returns at once: synthesis runs in the background, the result lands in the speech records, and only a failure comes back as an audio.sing_failed event.

lyrics.description: Lyrics to sing; Chinese characters. Punctuation only splits phrases.

silent.description: Sing only; do not play. The path and an audio blob handle come back as an audio.sing_done event.

summary.zh: 用 DiffSinger 把歌词唱出来并播放。
summary.en: Sings lyrics with DiffSinger and plays the song.

tools.name: audio_transcribe
tools.description: Transcribe an audio file (a local path, or a log:/mem: blob handle) with the configured speech-to-text engine. Returns at once: transcription runs in the background, the text lands in the transcript records and comes back as an audio.transcribed event; a failure comes back as audio.transcribe_failed.

path.description: Absolute path to the audio file; give this or handle.

handle.description: A log:/mem: blob handle for the audio; give this or path.

summary.zh: 转写一个音频文件，完成后以事件带回文字。
summary.en: Transcribes an audio file in the background; the text arrives as an event.

tools.name: audio_listen
tools.description: Start, stop or inspect hearing: system audio, the microphone, or one application. Lanes split audio by voice activity and transcribe each chunk, or — when a lane is set to streaming — transcribe live and cut sentences by the engine endpoints. Transcribed sentences land in the transcript records (no audio files are kept). With delivery set to notify, each audio.heard is pushed with trigger=debounce, so the core batches close sentences into one wake-up (window and batch limits come from the framework batching settings).

source.description: system, mic, or an application process name / PID. Omit to start or stop every configured lane.

summary.zh: 开始、停止或查看本机声音监听。

tools.name: audio_queue
tools.description: Inspect or change the playback queue: list it, skip the current item, remove one queued item by id, or stop and clear everything.

id.description: Queue id to remove (only for act=remove).

summary.en: Inspect or change the playback queue.

description.zh: 从某一路声音里切出一块并（可自动）转成文字，正文存进转写记录；事件默认只归档，打开「通知 Coo」时按内核 debounce 投递，几句会在同一次唤醒里一起给到模型。
description.en: A chunk was cut from one listening lane and transcribed (when enabled); the text goes to the transcript records. Archived by default; with notify on the event is pushed with trigger=debounce, so the core batches close sentences into one wake-up.

description.zh: 后台合成一句话失败了；成功不打扰。
description.en: A background audio_say synthesis failed; successes stay silent.

description.zh: 后台变声失败了；成功不打扰。
description.en: A background audio_convert conversion failed; successes stay silent.

description.zh: 后台唱歌失败了；成功不打扰。
description.en: A background audio_sing synthesis failed; successes stay silent.

description.zh: silent 合成完成，带回本地路径与音频附件句柄。
description.en: A silent audio_say finished; it carries the local path and the audio as a blob attachment.

description.zh: 后台转写完成，带回文字。
description.en: A background transcription finished; it carries the text.

description.zh: silent 变声完成，带回本地路径与音频附件句柄。
description.en: A silent audio_convert finished; it carries the local path and the audio as a blob attachment.

description.zh: silent 唱歌完成，带回本地路径与音频附件句柄。
description.en: A silent audio_sing finished; it carries the local path and the audio as a blob attachment.

changelog.0.1.0:
- 首个版本：把「听、转写、说话、唱歌、变声、播放」收进一个 World，取代原来的 tts / stt / listen / audio-play 四个扩展。
- 本机引擎：GPT-SoVITS（说话）、SenseVoice 与 Paraformer 流式（转写）、DiffSinger 绮萱（唱歌）、RVC（变声）；
  说话/唱歌/变声的子进程按需启动、空闲退出。
- 听：系统环回 / 按应用 / 麦克风，能量门限、Silero、FireRed VAD 切分，FireRed AED 区分说话 / 唱歌 / 音乐；
  听到的话自动转成文字存进「记录 → 转写」，不落音频文件；「通知 Coo」按内核 debounce 合批唤醒。
- 配音输出：说话、变声、唱歌的成品都在 `audio/out/`，面板可试听、复制路径、逐条删除或清空。
- 依赖页一键获取：uv、ffmpeg、GPT-SoVITS 源码与权重、RVC 源码与资产、DiffSinger 声库与声码器、VAD 与识别模型；
  运行时与权重放部署根，数据在 `data/audio/`。
- 导航加了状态灯：听 / 说话 / 变声 / 唱歌各自可确认的状态（悬停说缺什么），开车时另有一个「在听 N 路」徽章；不展示依赖计数、档位这类技术细节。
- 说话 / 变声 / 唱歌都有 `silent`：不播放，完成事件带回本地路径 + Core 分配的音频附件句柄（`audio.say_done` / `audio.convert_done` / `audio.sing_done`）；播放、变声、转写也接受 `log:`/`mem:` 句柄作为输入。
- 工具全部非阻塞：`audio_say` 的 `silent` 与 `audio_transcribe` 也改为立刻回执，结果分别以 `audio.say_done` / `audio.transcribed` 事件带回（失败 `audio.say_failed` / `audio.transcribe_failed`）。
- 工具：`audio_status`、`audio_play`、`audio_say`、`audio_convert`、`audio_sing`、`audio_transcribe`、`audio_listen`、`audio_queue`；
  事件：`audio.started`、`audio.heard`、`audio.say_failed`、`audio.convert_failed`、`audio.sing_failed`。
